Member the Pontiac Fiero? I wanted that car so bad in the 80s.
Yeah, they pretty much still have a cult following.
It's a HORRIBLE car, but low mile ones go for almost 30k.
But I would have been totally rad just cruisin' around in one while sporting my Members Only jacket, OP t-shirt, Levi's 501 jeans, VANS, Ray-Bans and spiked hair.

You can pick one up for not-so cheep, and since the design flaws are better understood now maintenance is easy. A lot of the bad rep comes from not only the questionable placement of some cooling tubes, but from the fact that many of the cars released had misprinted owners manuals and dipsticks.

It is an OK 80's hobby car, parts are cheap and answers are available for all kinds of questions, the fan community is STRONG. Honestly they look better than they drive. Don't get me wrong they are still a riot to drive, especially with the popular Oldsmobile quad-four engine swap, but there are better, safer, and cheaper cars to get your 80's style kicks on.

Some like Toyota's MR2 even have very effective electric conversion kits. Though even if you are handy with a wrench leave a conversion like that to the professionals.
My step-brother had one back when we were in high school. My mid 90s civic could kick its ass in a 1/4.
Why the fuck would you want one of these pieces of shit?
